objectives.en: Say every fact from twelve times one to twelve times twelve without help.
objectives.yo: Sọ gbogbo fact láti twelve times one dé twelve times twelve láìsí ìrànlọ́wọ́.
objectives.pcm: Talk every fact from twelve times one reach twelve times twelve without help.

objectives.en: Answer any twelve times fact out of order.
objectives.yo: Dáhùn èyíkéyìí twelve times fact láìtẹ̀lé ètò.
objectives.pcm: Answer any twelve times fact wey no follow order.

curriculum.note: NERDC's primary ceiling is 9 x 9; no class requires this table. Kept as enrichment after Primary 3.

say.en: Look at three groups of twelve mangoes. Today we count in twelves.
say.pcm: Look three groups of twelve mango. Today we go count twelve twelve.
say.yo: Wo groups three ti twelve mango. Lónìí a ó kà ní twelve twelve.

say.en: Today you will learn the twelve times table. Then you will say it by yourself.
say.pcm: Today you go learn table twelve. Then you go talk am by yourself.
say.yo: Lónìí ìwọ yóò kọ́ table twelve. Lẹ́yìn náà, ìwọ yóò sọ ọ́ fúnra rẹ.

say.en: Do you remember the eleven times table? What is eleven times four?
say.pcm: You remember table eleven? Eleven times four na how much?
say.yo: Ṣé o rántí table eleven? Kí ni eleven times four?

say.en: Three groups of twelve mangoes show this. We count twelve, twenty-four, thirty-six. Twelve times three is thirty-six.
say.pcm: See three groups of twelve mango: twelve, twenty-four, thirty-six. Twelve times three na thirty-six.
say.yo: Wo groups mẹ́ta ti twelve mango: twelve, twenty-four, thirty-six. Twelve times three jẹ́ thirty-six.

say.en: Say it with me: twelve times three is thirty-six.
say.pcm: Say am with me: twelve times three na thirty-six.
say.yo: Sọ ọ́ pọ̀ mọ́ mi: twelve times three jẹ́ thirty-six.

say.en: Say the twelve times table. Start with twelve times one. End with twelve times twelve.
say.pcm: Say table twelve. Start with twelve times one. End with twelve times twelve.
say.yo: Sọ table twelve. Bẹ̀rẹ̀ pẹ̀lú twelve times one. Parí pẹ̀lú twelve times twelve.

say.en: Let us fix the ones you missed. Listen, then say them with me.
say.pcm: Make we fix the ones you miss. Hear them, then say them with me.
say.yo: Jẹ́ ká tún àwọn tí o pàdánù ṣe. Gbọ́, lẹ́yìn náà sọ wọ́n pọ̀ mọ́ mi.

say.pcm: Twelve times seven na how much?

say.en: Well done. Tomorrow we check the twelve times table once more.
say.pcm: You do well. Tomorrow we go check table twelve again.
say.yo: O ṣe dáadáa. Lọ́la a ó tún ṣàyẹ̀wò table twelve.
